purpose: Enable structured local outcome capture without hand-editing the full model; no prediction algorithm adoption or life-benefit claim
acceptance: Read-only preview binds explicit outcome event time, fixed existing horizon, immutable fresh before-observation IDs, current action definitions and full resource inputs; missing/conflicting/corrected/range-valued baselines cannot be fabricated
Only explicit confirmed full action execution plus typed finite in-domain outcomes and provenance can create a learning episode; accepting/completing a task alone never creates labels
Server controls new observed-record knowledge timestamp; client cannot submit recorded_at, future outcome timestamps, guessed confidence or qualitative scores
Current revision compare-and-swap prevents concurrent lost updates; identical event retry is idempotent, changed event payload rejected; validation before all persistence
Next as-of fit uses new mature evidence; prediction before outcome registration unchanged; sparse data retains abstention and legacy prediction algorithm
Backup/restart preserves complete immutable revision chain, outcomes and resource commitments; outcomes do not silently spend/free planning resources
Actual browser form on isolated synthetic workspace records an outcome, reports invalid/missing data, and retains no fake observed values; no external inference or private-data export
Full existing suite plus targeted API/revision/temporal/backup tests; Python3.10/3.12 remote CI and installed wheel smoke test
functional_adoption_gate: All acceptance cases and existing regression checks pass. Performance/calibration adoption remains blocked; no scientific benefit inferred from endpoint success.
private_data_policy: Synthetic inputs only in public artifacts. All future user observations stay in the existing local private data store/backup; no new telemetry or MLflow service.
